description: Recipient binding vectors: the allowlist keyed by recipient_ref and the (address, tag) pair, tag mismatches, the three recipient modes, attestation counts, removal before execute and allowlist entry validation.

vectors.description: In ALLOWLIST mode a listed (recipient_ref, destination) pair with no attestations is requested, still listed at execute, and paid.
A destination missing from the allowlist, or listed only under another recipient_ref, is refused with RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED.
An entry allowlisted with tag 1 does not cover tag 2 at the same address (RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED); tag 1 itself is requested and paid.
An entry allowlisted with tag 1 does not cover the same address with no tag, which is refused with RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED.
An entry allowlisted with no tag does not cover a tagged sub-account of that address (RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED), tag 0 included.
Every leg is checked against the allowlist: a listed first leg and an unlisted second leg are refused with RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED.
In ALLOWLIST mode a request carrying an attestation is refused with ATTESTATION_INVALID even for a listed destination.
In ATTESTED mode two legs with one attestation, one leg with none and one leg with two are each refused with ATTESTATION_INVALID.
In BOTH mode an attested but unlisted destination is RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED, a listed one without attestation is ATTESTATION_INVALID, and both together pass.
In BOTH mode the allowlist is checked before the attestation of the same leg: an unlisted leg with an expired attestation is RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED.
A destination disallowed after its payout was approved stops execute with RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED, and allowing it again lets the payout run.
In BOTH mode a removal leaves policy_epoch alone; with both a removal and a policy change, execute reports RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED first, then POLICY_CHANGED.
An ATTESTED mandate has no allowlist: allow_recipients and disallow_recipients are refused with WRONG_RECIPIENT_MODE.
An allowlist entry naming the fee address is refused with CONFIG_INVALID, with no tag and with a tag, to allow and to disallow.
allow_recipients adds three entries, two at one address under different tags, with one event each in order; disallow removes one.
Allowing a present entry or the same entry twice, or disallowing an absent entry or one twice, is CONFIG_INVALID and changes nothing.
On Celo an allowlist entry with the zero address is refused with CONFIG_INVALID, to allow and to disallow.
On Celo an allowlist entry whose tag is marked absent but carries 7 is refused with CONFIG_INVALID.
